title: Computer Networks
subject: computer-networks
description: Flip-card revision for computer networks — OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, switching, and protocols for fast C-CAT recall before the exam.

cards.front: How many layers does the OSI model have?
cards.back: 7 — Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application

cards.front: How many layers does the TCP/IP model have?
TCP vs UDP — which is connection-oriented and reliable?
cards.back: TCP. UDP is connectionless and unreliable, but faster — used for streaming/gaming

cards.front: Usable host addresses in a /24 subnet
cards.back: 254 — 256 total minus one for the network address and one for the broadcast address

cards.front: Which device forwards data based on MAC address?
Which device forwards data based on IP address?

cards.back: Distance Vector — routers share their routing tables, decisions based on hop count
Link State — each router builds a full map of the network topology

cards.front: Which error detection method best catches burst errors?
What switching technique does the modern internet use?
cards.back: Packet switching — data split into packets, routed independently
Translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses
